::: {#def-saturated-deviance}

#### Deviance relative to the saturated model

The **deviance relative to the saturated model** of a fitted model is twice the amount by which its maximized log-likelihood $\llikf{\hvcoef}$ falls short of the maximized log-likelihood $\satllik$ of the [saturated model](#def-saturated-model):

$$
\satdeviance = 2 \paren{\satllik - \llikf{\hvcoef}}.
$$ {#eq-saturated-deviance}

:::
